paragraphs.text: Monoxa is a vampire employee and works as the midway manager of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Monoxa has been hired by Myra to keep the Astrotorium running in her stead. She was originally an employee like other vampires at the midway, but worked her way up through the ranks and eventually became its manager.

While Truss fixes the electrical and technological issues of the park, Monoxa deals with the park's "people issues." She makes sure all the staff are doing their jobs and are in the right place at the right time. She is willing to help with any guest issues that may arise. She is very good at her job, though she can be cold-blooded. She is known to use whatever resources she needs to solve a problem, including working with the parks' pests. She cares about what she does, and she knows she is good at it. She makes sure to hire the right type of creatures to run different parts of the park, including staffing the midway with vampires.
